title: How to Read a Property Layout Plan (Naqsha) Before Buying?
excerpt: When purchasing property in Pakistan, a seller may show you a naqsha, floor plan, site plan, or society layout plan. These plans show different things, so you should know what you are looking at.
author: ABS Developers

body.text: When purchasing property in Pakistan, a seller may show you a naqsha, floor plan, site plan, or society layout plan. These plans show different things, so you should know what you are looking at.
Know which plan you are looking at
A society layout plan shows plots, roads, parks and commercial areas. A site plan shows one plot and its boundaries, while a floor plan shows the rooms inside a building.
What to check

items: Plot or unit number matches your documents
Approved status from the relevant authority
Covered area versus the area you are paying for

body.text: Ask for the approved version of every plan and compare it with what is on the ground before you pay.

title: Orange Line Metro’s Impact on Lahore Real Estate Prices
excerpt: The Orange Line Metro’s impact on Lahore real estate prices can be significant because it makes it easier to travel to parts of Lahore.
author: ABS Developers

body.text: The Orange Line Metro’s impact on Lahore real estate prices can be significant because it makes it easier to travel to parts of Lahore.
Mass transit shortens commutes, which raises demand for homes and shops within walking distance of stations.
Where the effect shows
As with any infrastructure project, buyers should look at the full neighbourhood rather than the station alone.

title: Lahore Ring Road: How It’s Changing Property Values Nearby
excerpt: The Lahore Ring Road can affect property values by making travel around the city easier. It can help people reach main roads, business areas, and the airport.
author: ABS Developers

body.text: The Lahore Ring Road can affect property values by making travel around the city easier. It can help people reach main roads, business areas, and the airport.
Better connectivity tends to pull residential and commercial demand towards interchanges.
Several ABS developments — including ABS Executive, ABS Central and ABS Mall & Residency — sit on or beside Ring Road interchanges for this reason.

title: Bank Home Financing vs Developer Installment Plans: Which Costs Less Long-Term?
excerpt: Neither selection is always inexpensive. Bank home financing typically means paying the bank more through a markup, profit, or rental payments over a longer period.
author: ABS Developers

body.text: Neither selection is always inexpensive. Bank home financing typically means paying the bank more through a markup, profit, or rental payments over a longer period.
Developer instalment plans are usually shorter and may carry no markup at all.
The ABS approach
ABS Developers follows a Riba-free policy: whether you pay in full or follow the instalment plan, the agreed price remains the same, and there are no late-payment fees.

title: Property Insurance in Pakistan: Is It Worth It for Homeowners?
excerpt: Property insurance can help homeowners cover major losses if a covered event damages their home or belongings.
author: ABS Developers

body.text: Property insurance can help homeowners cover major losses if a covered event damages their home or belongings.
Policies differ in what they cover — fire, flood, theft and structural damage are common inclusions.
Read the exclusions carefully and confirm whether building insurance is already arranged by your building management.

title: Apartment Maintenance and Service Charges Explained
excerpt: Apartment maintenance, or service charges, are regular fees paid to maintain an apartment building’s shared areas and facilities.
author: ABS Developers

body.text: Apartment maintenance, or service charges, are regular fees paid to maintain an apartment building’s shared areas and facilities.
These charges may cover cleaning, security, lifts, water supply and upkeep of common areas.

items: Usually included: security, cleaning, lift maintenance, common-area utilities
Usually not included: your own unit’s utilities and interior repairs

title: First-Time Home Buyer Mistakes to Avoid in Pakistan
excerpt: Purchasing a home for the first time is a great financial decision. Minor mistakes can cause serious complications later.
author: ABS Developers

body.text: Purchasing a home for the first time is a great financial decision. Minor mistakes can cause serious complications later.
Many buyers focus on price alone. Location, documentation, developer track record and total cost of ownership matter just as much.

title: Difference Between a Housing Society and a Cooperative Housing Scheme in Pakistan
excerpt: A housing society is a common term used for an intended residential area. A cooperative housing society has a specific structure in which members own and govern it together.
author: ABS Developers

body.text: A housing society is a common term used for an intended residential area. A cooperative housing society has a specific structure in which members own and govern it together.
Understanding who owns the land and who approves plans helps you judge the risks of any purchase.

title: File Possession vs Physical Possession: What Every Plot or Apartment Buyer Should Know
excerpt: If you are purchasing property in Pakistan, file possession and physical possession are not the same.
author: ABS Developers

body.text: If you are purchasing property in Pakistan, file possession and physical possession are not the same.
A property file, allotment letter or possession letter gives you rights on paper. Physical possession means the unit is handed over and you can use it.
Always ask when physical possession is expected and what is required to receive it.

title: Token Money vs Down Payment vs Booking Amount: Pakistan Real Estate Terms Explained
excerpt: When purchasing property in Pakistan, you may hear terms like token money, booking amount, and down payment.
author: ABS Developers

body.text: When purchasing property in Pakistan, you may hear terms like token money, booking amount, and down payment.

items: Token money: a small amount that holds a deal while documents are checked
Booking amount: the payment that reserves a unit with a developer
Down payment: the first major instalment towards the full price

title: Freehold vs Leasehold Property in Pakistan: Key Differences Explained
excerpt: When talking about property in Pakistan, freehold and leasehold refer to different types of property ownership rights.
author: ABS Developers

body.text: When talking about property in Pakistan, freehold and leasehold refer to different types of property ownership rights.
Freehold property typically means you own the property and the land for an unlimited period. Leasehold means you hold rights for a fixed term under a lease.

title: Carpet Area vs Covered Area vs Super Area in Pakistan: What Buyers Actually Pay For
excerpt: If an apartment is listed as 1,500 sq ft, it doesn’t always mean you get 1,500 sq ft of living space.
author: ABS Developers

body.text: If an apartment is listed as 1,500 sq ft, it doesn’t always mean you get 1,500 sq ft of living space.

items: Carpet area: usable floor area inside the walls
Covered area: carpet area plus wall thickness
Super area: covered area plus a share of common areas

body.text: ABS Developers publishes net and gross areas for each unit type so you can compare clearly.
